_note: What you see: Align logo, colours, favicon and background of Nextcloud with the set
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Logo, kleuren, favicon en achtergrond van Nextcloud gelijkzetten met de set
Het Nextcloud-thema bijwerken naar Gemee: Update the Nextcloud theme to Gemeente Zuiddrecht?
Thematiq zet de waarden van Nextcloud ge: Thematiq aligns the Nextcloud values with the token set, so sign-in page, email and apps show the same house style. Only values that differ are listed here; without a proposed value something stays as it is.
Kiest u de tokenset Nextcloud, dan stelt: If you choose the token set Nextcloud, the same dialog asks "Reset the Nextcloud theme to the default?" with the Nextcloud default values in the Proposed column.
